data.scope: All1100 authored frames; three probe points per nonspace glyph in reading and exiting text (effective opacity>=0.2). Actual DOM paint order, circular clipping and source PNG alpha respected. Hidden reverse paper and intentional semantic strike-through explicitly excluded; complements actual encoded dense-frame review, not universal pixel OCR.
